subject: Follow-up: Compliance intake, SOC 2 status, and PT handoff for Orchestrix
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@orchestrix.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Compliance intake, SOC 2 status, and PT handoff for Orchestrix

Hi Maya —

Really enjoyed the demo earlier; appreciate the time you and the product team took. Per our conversation, I wanted to capture the compliance/security items we discussed and propose a practical next-step plan so we can keep the procurement timeline moving. Quick recap of asks on your side and what we need from Redwood: 

- SOC 2 status: you asked whether we have recent SOC 2 artifacts available for review.
- GDPR/HIPAA alignment: you mentioned GDPR applies and HIPAA is relevant for a subset of your product.
- Pen test & vuln process: you’d like to see our most recent pen test handback + understand our vulnerability SLA, scanning cadence, and disclosure process.
- Vendor questionnaire: you indicated you have a standard security questionnaire.

Proposed next steps (feel free to adjust):
1) I’ll share our security packet and a sanitized pen test handback under NDA.
2) You send over your vendor security questionnaire (or attach to this thread).
3) Rafael from our security engineering team will confirm expected triage SLAs and scanning cadence; Neha will own the intake checklist and Docs/HubSpot updates.
4) If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute security handoff next week to walk the artifacts.

Timeline we’re hoping for: deliver initial artifacts within 3 business days if NDA is in place.

Attached: Redwood_security_packet.pdf (high-level SOC/controls summary, encryption/KMS notes, contact for audits).

Would appreciate confirmation of: whether you can accept a sanitized pen test report under NDA, and the preferred owner for the questionnaire on your side.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com] | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@orchestrix.com>

Cc: security@orchestrix.com
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Compliance intake, SOC 2 status, and PT handoff for Orchestrix

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few items from our side:

- SOC 2: We are in the process of our SOC 2 Type II audit (started Q1 2026). Final report expected Q4 2026. We can accept vendor SOC 2 artifacts (SOC bridge/controls matrix) as interim evidence.
- GDPR/HIPAA: GDPR is fully in scope for Orchestrix. HIPAA applies to specific modules; we’ll note which modules map to PHI and can highlight requirements.
- Pen test reports: We typically accept a sanitized handback (no exploitable PII) under NDA. We also run our own third-party assessment for high-risk vendors.
- Vulnerability SLA / cadence: please describe your triage SLA and scanning cadence — our procurement/security team will evaluate alignment with our risk policy.
- Vendor questionnaire: attached (orchestrix_security_questionnaire.xlsx). Please have your security or compliance team fill and return.

We are happy to have a short technical call; our security owner (security@orchestrix.com) can join. Our timeline: we’d like to collect artifacts by the end of next week so our procurement team can progress to legal review.

Attaching: orchestrix_security_questionnaire.xlsx (vendor security questionnaire)

Best,
Maya Singh
Head of Technical Programs | Orchestrix
maya.singh@orchestrix.com

Neha / Rafael — looping you both in to confirm we can meet Orchestrix’s asks and to propose an intake plan. See Maya’s reply (below) and the attached questionnaire.

My proposed plan:
- Artifacts to provide to Orchestrix: sanitized pen test handback (redacted for PII/exploitable PoC), controls matrix (SOC bridge), encryption/KMS summary, and asset inventory snapshot relevant to their integration.
- NDA: share draft_mutual_NDA.docx for signature before sending the sanitized report.
- Vulnerability triage SLA (proposed): Critical: 72 hours from acknowledgment; High: 7 days; Medium: 30 days; Low: 90 days. These are our suggested SLAs for production-facing issues tied to Orchestrix integration. Rafael, can you confirm these are realistic?
- Scanning cadence (proposed): Quarterly authenticated scans for production + ad-hoc scans tied to major releases.
- Disclosure policy: 90-day coordinated disclosure window for external vulnerability reports; emergency exceptions handled case-by-case.

Attachments to prepare: redwood_pt_handback_sanitized.pdf (sanitized), Redwood_security_packet.pdf (already shared), draft_mutual_NDA.docx (for signatures).

Next actions:
1) Rafael to confirm the SLA/cadence and indicate if we need to run any additional scans before handoff.
2) Neha to complete the vendor questionnaire and return a filled copy to Maya.
3) Jordan to send NDA and initiate DocuSign after Rafael confirms pen report readiness.

HubSpot: I’ve attached the next steps to ORCH-2026-3742 and will mark as security-intake in our playbook.

Thanks —
